title: 生涯学習特別科目（技術者のためのマーケティング入門）
subtitle: Special Subject - Lifelong Learning(Marketing for Engineers)
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal: The term marketing is often used in a narrow sense, such as advertising, publicity, and sales promotion activities. Still, it has a broader meaning, such as "activities to come up with products and services that are beneficial to consumers, realize them, and increase mutual satisfaction and results ." The main purpose of this course is to acquire the basics of management that engineers need to understand in this broad sense, conduct research and analysis of actual company data, and participate in marketing activities.
advice:
[Class Outline (Procedure)]
○ Each class will have a lecture on a variety of marketing-related themes.
○ PowerPoint materials will be used in class. Important keywords and points will be raised, and students will deepen their understanding of the theory through group research and discussion of case studies.
[Advice]
○ Students are expected to have their own opinions, rather than simply memorizing knowledge.
○ Students will be expected to pay attention to the latest market information and express their own opinions and interpretations of market trends. When doing so, students will be required to provide objective evidence as to why they think that way.

achievementLevels.ideal:
① Understand the objectives and requirements of marketing, and be able to logically explain the importance of marketing activities in a company.
② Be able to clearly explain important concepts related to marketing in simple terms.
③ Be able to explain in detail the similarities and differences between the marketing methods of each product in the target market.
④ Be able to understand and clearly explain the need for brand building in a company.
⑤ Be able to constantly observe trends in a specific market of interest, concisely summarize market trends, and explain them in an easy-to-understand manner.
achievementLevels.standard:
① Understand the objectives and requirements of marketing, and be able to generally explain the importance of marketing activities in companies.
② Be able to explain important concepts related to marketing to some extent.
③ Be able to explain the similarities and differences in the marketing methods of each product in the target market to some extent.
④ Be able to understand and explain the necessity of brand building in companies to some extent.
⑤ Be able to continuously observe the trends of a specific market of interest, and be able to summarize and explain market trends to some extent.
